newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Droga says to up 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Droga says to up 1996 dividend.

text.p: Slovenian food maker Droga Portoroz said on Tuesday it proposed to raise its 1996 dividend payment to 1,062 tolars per share from 784 tolars the previous year.

The proposal, which is expected to win shareholder approval at the end of May, was in line with previous announcements that the firm would boost its dividend by about 30 percent after 1996 net profit jumped 35.6 percent to 858.2 million tolars.
Droga is listed on the main market of the Ljubljana bourse. On Tuesday its price was unchanged at 26,900 tolars on volume of 25 shares.
-- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 157.6 Slovenian Tolars)
